questions.question: The pattern goes: sun, moon, star, cloud, sun, moon, star, cloud, sun. What is the 10th picture?
questions.explain: The group of 4 is sun, moon, star, cloud. After two full groups (8), the 10th is the 2nd in the next group: moon. A common slip is just saying the last picture you saw, which was sun.

questions.question: The pattern is: red, yellow, green, red, yellow, green, red, yellow. What is the 9th colour?
questions.explain: The group is red, yellow, green. Nine is exactly three full groups, so it lands on the last one: green. Don't just copy the colour you last saw, which was yellow.

questions.question: The sounds go: clap, stomp, snap, clap, stomp, snap, clap, stomp. What is the 9th sound?
questions.explain: The group is clap, stomp, snap. Nine is three full groups, so it lands on the last sound: snap. The trap is just repeating the last sound you heard, which was stomp.

questions.question: Sara is making a bead bracelet. The beads go: red, blue, green, red, blue, green, red, blue, green. What colour is the 10th bead?
questions.explain: The group is red, blue, green. After three groups (9), the 10th starts a new group: red. Be careful not to just copy the last bead, which was green.

questions.question: At the dance, the music goes: clap, stomp, snap, clap, stomp, snap, clap. What is the 11th sound?
questions.explain: The group is clap, stomp, snap. After three groups (9), the 11th is the 2nd in the next group: stomp. Don't just repeat the last sound, which was clap.

questions.question: Tom paints fence stripes: blue, white, red, blue, white, red, blue. What colour is the 14th stripe?
questions.explain: The group is blue, white, red. Four groups make 12, so the 14th is the 2nd in the next group: white. A common trap is to just say the last stripe, which was blue.

questions.question: Leo builds a tower. The block colours repeat: red, blue, green, yellow, red, blue, green, yellow. He has made 8 blocks. What colour is the 14th block?
questions.explain: The group is red, blue, green, yellow. Three groups make 12, so the 14th is the 2nd in the next group: blue. Watch out for copying the last block, which was yellow.

questions.question: A caterpillar walks: left, right, up, down, left, right, up, down. A bird asks, 'Where is it on the 13th step?' Where is the caterpillar?
questions.explain: The group is left, right, up, down. Three groups make 12, so the 13th starts a new group: left. The key step is to find the group of 4 first, then count into it.

questions.question: Priya writes a number pattern: 3, 7, 1, 3, 7, 1, 3, 7, 1, __. What number goes in the blank?
questions.explain: The group is 3, 7, 1. Nine is three full groups, so the 10th starts fresh: 3. A common slip is to just write the last number (1) or the next one (7).

questions.question: The letters repeat: A, B, C, D, A, B, C, D. What is the 10th letter?
questions.explain: Count on in the A, B, C, D order: the 9th is A, so the 10th is B. Stopping one early gives A by mistake.

questions.question: A pattern repeats: 4, 9, 6, 2, 4, 9, 6. What is the 13th number?
questions.explain: The core 4, 9, 6, 2 ends on the 12th number with 2, so the 13th starts the core again with 4. Do not just repeat the 6 you can see.

questions.question: These letters repeat: R, S, T, U, R, S. What is the 12th letter?
questions.explain: R, S, T, U repeat, so every 4th letter is U. The 12th is U, not the S you see at the end of the list.

questions.question: A pattern repeats: 1, 5, 3, 8, 1. What is the 11th number?
questions.explain: The core 1, 5, 3, 8 puts 8 on the 8th and 1 on the 9th, so the 10th is 5 and the 11th is 3. Counting one too far gives 8.

questions.question: Mia makes a paper chain for class. The link colours repeat: pink, black, brown, white, pink, black. What colour is the 12th link?
questions.explain: The core is pink, black, brown, white, so every 4th link is white and the 12th is white. Brown is the 11th link, one too soon.

questions.question: Sam makes a necklace. The beads repeat: green, black, silver, gold. He has made 8 beads. What is the best way to find the colour of the 18th bead?
options: Count the 4 colours in order up to 17.
Use the colour of the last bead he made.
Count the 4 colours in order up to 18.
Count the 4 colours in order up to 19.
questions.explain: Say the core green, black, silver, gold over and over and stop right on 18. Stopping on 17 or copying the bead he just made gives the wrong colour.

questions.question: At camp the snack order repeats: apple, grape, plum, pear, apple, grape. What is the 16th snack?
questions.explain: Pear ends each group of four, so the 16th snack is pear. Plum is the 15th, one too soon.

questions.question: Cara lines up her hair clips in a repeating order: blue, pink, green, black, blue, pink, green. What colour is the 13th clip?
questions.explain: The core blue, pink, green, black puts black on the 12th, so the 13th starts the core again with blue. Do not repeat the green you see at the end.

questions.question: Ravi stamps shapes in a repeating order: leaf, fish, bear, boat. He has stamped 9 shapes. He stamps 2 more. What shape is the last one?
questions.explain: The 9th stamp is leaf, so the 10th is fish and the 11th is bear. The next stamps are not leaf again.

questions.question: Tia hangs winter things in a repeating order: sock, hat, mitt, scarf, sock, hat, __, scarf. What is the 14th thing she hangs?
questions.explain: The missing 7th thing is mitt. Scarf ends each group of four, so the 12th is scarf, the 13th is sock and the 14th is hat.

questions.question: The animals repeat: duck, frog, crab, seal, duck, frog, crab. Ana says the 10th animal is crab. Is she right?
options: No, it is duck. Duck is just before frog.
Yes, it is crab. Crab is the 10th one.
No, it is seal. Seal comes after crab.
No, it is frog. She copied the last one.
questions.explain: Count on from the crab: the 8th is seal, the 9th is duck, the 10th is frog. Copying the last animal you can see does not work.

questions.question: Kai has a sticker chart that repeats: sun, rain, snow, wind, sun, rain. Kai is on sticker 9 today. Which sticker comes 6 stickers later?
questions.explain: Sticker 9 is sun, so count on 6 more: rain, snow, wind, sun, rain, snow. The 15th sticker is snow, not another sun.
